__NOTOC__
== Ingredients ==
*1 bone-in cooked city [[Cookbook:Ham|ham]], skin removed
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] dried [[Cookbook:Apple|apples]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]] finely
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Chop Rub|Chop Rub]]
*¾ cup [[Cookbook:Cola|cola]]

== Procedure ==
#Place ham in a large [[Cookbook:Roasting Pan|roasting pan]] large side down.
#Bake at 250°F for 1 hour.
#Take ham out from oven and brush generously with cola. Pat on the chop rub, and then pat on apples.
#Bake for another 1 ½ hours at 250°F 
#Remove and let rest 10 minutes. [[Cookbook:Slicing|Slice]] thinly and serve.
